Name: (CP) Abigail as Nana Osaki
Author: armoredlovecat
Description:
Changes a few dialogue lines and Abigail's appereance.
Inspired by Nana's outfits from the anime, manga and official art.


[b]Disclaimer:
The mod might not work if you are using other mods that change Abigail's appereance since SMAPI loads them in alphabetical order. As someone suggested in comments, you could use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098?tab=description]"Generic Mod Config Menu"[/url] to solve this.[/b]


I'll try making a [b]Sesonal Outfits[/b] version soon with more cool Nana clothes.

⋆𐙚₊˚⊹♡This is my first mod so let me know if something's wrong and I'll try my best to fix it! ⋆𐙚₊˚⊹♡
